label: team_circle_win_01_02
text:
When you use the Union Circle, you can gather
with friends at one of the Pokémon Centers in
the region and play together.\c
If your connection gets interrupted while you’re
playing with friends through the Union Circle,
you’ll be automatically removed from the group.\c
If the Trainer who formed the group loses their
connection, the whole group will be disbanded.\c
Try your best to play in an environment with a
strong and steady connection!
